company.name: Markaz Technologies
company.shortDescription: Markaz is an online reselling platform for anyone in Pakistan to source wholesale products and start an online business with zero investment
company.description:
Markaz provides an online reselling platform to help anyone in Pakistan source wholesale products from across the country and sell with a profit through their own social media stores on WhatsApp and Facebook without investing any money, from the comfort of their home.

Markaz is on a mission to supercharge the rails of ecommerce and make it accessible to masses in Pakistan by enabling and empowering micro-entrepreneurs.

productsAndServices.description: An online platform connecting resellers in Pakistan with suppliers for dropshipping, enabling sales without inventory management.
productsAndServices.name: Markaz Dropshipping Platform

productsAndServices.description: A mobile app enabling users in Pakistan to resell products online with zero investment, managing inventory, orders, and payments.
productsAndServices.name: Markaz Mobile Application (Markaz App)

productsAndServices.description: A service that integrates Markaz’s dropshipping catalog with Shopify stores, automating product import and order fulfillment.
productsAndServices.name: Shopify Integration Service

productsAndServices.description: Customer support and analytics tools for resellers to monitor sales, profits, and optimize their dropshipping business.
productsAndServices.name: Markaz Reseller Support and Analytics

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,272,607 to $17,063,420, a 3.99x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 28 (-3 over 90 days) and market heat at 60 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
